summary.text: Rebecca Bextel is the Constitution Party's candidate for governor, a small business owner who has lived in Wyoming for more than 20 years. She describes herself as a conservative choice and has focused on government accountability, energy, state sovereignty and gun and parental rights.

paragraphs.text: Born in Alabama to missionary parents; has lived in Wyoming for more than 20 years, built a small business there and raised four daughters.
